# Stock Quote

iOS 14 +

## Notes

Gets a quote for the provided stock symbol.

## Syntax

~~~~text
stockQuote(symbol: <#String (Allows Variables)#>)
~~~~

## Example

~~~~text
stockQuote(symbol: "$AAPL")
~~~~
